notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
Join us for our first Developer Livestream,
Where we'll play the game and answer your questions.
The livestream will start at the same time as Steam Next Fest, at 10 AM PDT / 6 PM BST.

notes.title: Blue Energy Kickstarter - 1st October! + Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[h1][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rowanfuture/blue-energy]The Kickstarter Link! - please wishlist to make sure you get an early discount :) [/url][/b][/h1]

Before Blue Energy goes to Early-Access, to help with the development of the game and to make sure its as high quality as it can be, we'll be launching a Kickstarter on October 1st!

Blue Energy will also be having a demo in Steam Next Fest to coincide with the Kickstarter!
We really hope you at least try it out :)
